questions.title: What does 'club-length' mean in golf?
questions.question: If you are told to drop your ball within one club-length, how do you know how far that is?

choices.text: It is the length of your longest club, but not your putter.
It can be any club you pick from your bag.
It is only as long as your driver.
It is only as long as your putter.

questions.explanation: A club-length is how long your longest club is, except for your putter. Lay your biggest club (not your putter) on the ground to check the distance.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The space as long as your biggest club (except the putter).
A special club used on the green to roll the ball into the hole.

questions.teachingTip: Show children the difference between a driver and a putter side-by-side so they can see which club is longest.
likelyMisconceptions: Kids might think they can use their putter to measure.
Kids might think any club in the bag can be used to measure.
